cohortRule: First 20 newly opened first-clear progression campaigns per person after the freeze, at or above the declared progression frontier; unfinished and missing forecasts remain in the cohort. Replays never contribute to the primary 80% score.

diagnostics.note: Earlier-opened campaigns may receive useful predictions, but cannot prove a new pre-start forecast. Replay diagnostic results do not contribute to the primary pass gate.

note: Earlier same-model new-progression forecasts and misses remain in the primary cohort. Adding progression coverage or clarifying replay exclusions never resets the earliest same-model freeze.
